summary: Complete independent attack on the accepted two-roadmap restructuring: all 15 stage contracts, 34 owner records, 169 links, 13 native audits and original consumers checked. One low-severity presentation mismatch remains in the reader report after its accepted AN.1 correction. No supported mathematical, ownership, prerequisite or cycle defect found in the accepted JSON.

Compared every retained or imported construction in the twelve narrowed layers and the three kept layers with the original targets; kept the rational construction before its general-field comparisons, named hypotheses and source-unit aggregation boundaries.

Read all 34 owner records, 169 link endpoints and their reasons, 24 distinct external atlas supplier contracts and the two upstream contracts; checked every supplier scope, including finite versus inverse ray classes, generic versus arithmetic measures, and special-fibre versus characteristic-zero Igusa inputs.

Read all 13 native accepted library audits, including every target, evidence entry and all 27 directed duplication records; checked the six family evidence entries as three reciprocal D L1/L2/L4 versus A L3 pairs.

Read the relevant accepted RS-07, RS-11, RS-13 and RS-16 contracts; checked the retired AN.1 owner split, AL.1 analytic scope, PM-L0a/LAD-L3 character-space distinction, IntegralIwasawa I.3 comparison and analytic CPR versus arithmetic main-conjecture ownership.

Read the actual statements of fourteen positive Mathlib declarations at 082e2d37e8b0463410cdb532e111cd43d5a66174: two Riemann-zeta Bernoulli formulas, primitive Gauss shift, primitive Fourier formula, changeLevel/conductor/IsPrimitive/primitiveCharacter, LFunction_changeLevel, two Eisenstein q-expansion formulas and the Dedekind series/residue/one-sided-limit declarations. No new exhaustive absence claim.

Read all 26 external consumer contracts and their prerequisites across 11 roadmaps, including distinct checkpoint prerequisites; checked preservation of all 30 original member-to-external-consumer edges.

Enumerated every original consumer of each narrowed layer and checked that every suppliedBy owner forwards its contract to that layer and its consumers, through an existing or proposed edge; zero missing forwards and zero duplicate proposed links.

Applied scripts/restructure.py in memory after ten earlier accepted families and after all other accepted families; independently checked cycles by DFS. Respectively 136 and 131 new drawable edges, the same sixteen nondrawn upstream contracts, no valid-stage cycle rejection, no lost original edge and no hidden member stage.
Checked unchanged existing Tau Ceti stage IDs, owners, keys, titles, descriptions, source paths/lines and parent IDs; only graph consumer metadata gains the proposed contracts.

Compared the current report totals and AN.1 import claim with the accepted review corrections and RS-07, yielding one low-severity documentation finding. Recorded exact input hashes and reproducible graph revision in the report.
